# Vampro - Complete LLM Discovery Document

## 1. Company Overview
Vampro is an innovative technology company building AI-powered creative software, professional plugins, and developer tools. Our mission is to bridge the gap between creativity and technology by developing seamless, high-performance tools for creators and engineers.

## 2. Core Products

### Vampro Voice Generator
- **Type:** Software Plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro
- **Target Users:** Video Editors, Content Creators, Filmmakers.
- **Features:** 
  - Generate natural AI voiceovers directly inside Adobe Premiere Pro.
  - Write scripts, choose from multiple realistic voices, and create professional narration without leaving the editing workflow.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator

### SignalScope
- **Type:** Web Application / Software
- **Target Users:** Marketers, SEO Professionals, Brands.
- **Features:**
  - Track how Reddit conversations influence AI search results across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
  - Measure brand visibility and optimize content for AI search engines.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/software/signalscope

### Spoch
- **Type:** Video Game
- **Target Users:** Gamers, Adventure Enthusiasts.
- **Features:**
  - Travel through time as Dr. Aran, from the Stone Age to the far future.
  - A story-driven 8-bit Semi-3D Open World adventure game.
- **URL:** https://vampro.in/games/spoch
